original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州一名25岁男子因涉嫌抢劫牛群被还押候审
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚贝努埃州马库尔迪一治安法院周三将25岁男子沙伊布·乌斯曼还押候审，其被指控参与抢劫16头牛，价值1500万奈拉。检方称约七名武装牧民袭击了两名投诉人并抢走牲畜，乌斯曼被指为头目，其本人已承认犯罪，其他嫌疑人仍在逃。案件因管辖权问题未当庭答辩，押后至10月27日再审。

location.raw_text: Makurdi, Benue; Table Water Riverside, along Agedagba Forest, Utonkon

key_facts.fact: 马库尔迪治安法院将25岁男子沙伊布·乌斯曼还押候审，其被指控抢劫16头牛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A Magistrate’s Court in Makurdi on Wednesday, remanded a 25-year-old man, Shaibu Usman, for alleged robbery of 16 cattle valued at N15 million.

key_facts.fact: 乌斯曼被控刑事共谋、武装抢劫和恐怖主义行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Usman who lives in Ekwerege, Ado Local Government Area of Benue, was charged with criminal conspiracy, armed robbery and acts of terrorism.

key_facts.fact: 检方称约七名武装牧民据称由乌斯曼带领袭击了两名投诉人并抢走16头牛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: about seven armed herders, allegedly led by Usman, also known as ‘Mobey’, attacked the complainants.

key_facts.fact: 乌斯曼已承认犯罪，其他嫌疑人仍在逃
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: police investigation led to the arrest of the accused, who admitted committing the offences, while other suspects were still at large.
ordered that the accused be remanded at the Correctional Service Centre, Makurdi, and adjourned the case until Oct. 27 for further mention.

uncertainties: 相关指控为检方单方陈述，尚未经法院审理确认
乌斯曼的答辩因管辖权问题未当庭进行
其他嫌疑人仍在逃，尚未归案
目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
